text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Even a denizen of the twilight knows that there's no dawn without light!
Come now, my blade will carve a path to a future as dazzling as the morning sun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
黄昏時の住人でも、
明けない夜がないことぐらい知ってるさ！
さあ、
朝日のように眩しい未来まで、
アタシの刀が切り開くよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
This is the end!
Fated Blade: BOND OF THE ROARING DRAGON AND HOWLING TIGER!!!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで終わりさ！
──縁の太刀・
龍吟虎嘯の絆！
